_comment: PLAY-READINESS-18 -- this file is INERT and intentionally emptied. It previously contained a stale package name (com.example.ai_social_copilot, not the real com.insightvalues.app), a dead Android OAuth client with an empty certificate_hash, and a Web OAuth client that did not match the app's real, current GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID (see .env). No com.google.gms.google-services Gradle plugin is applied anywhere under android/ (confirmed by search), so this file was never actually consumed by the build -- it was a misleading orphan, not a functional dependency. This project's real Google Sign-In configuration lives in .env (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID) and is unrelated to Firebase. If a genuine Firebase integration is ever added, regenerate this file for real from the Firebase console using the correct package name.
